CustomField.inlineHelpText: Involvement in customer specific specialized network strategy, projects, recruitment, customization. Excludes standard network updates, standard communication, or basic geoaccess or disruption reporting. Example 1: work with local market leads to develop provider recruitment strategy, deployment and tracking on behalf of a customer. Example 2: develop and manage a custom network recruitment process managed by the CMC. Involvement of a CNL (custom network liaison) should make this a 1.
CustomField.label: Network Strategy/Development
